segments.he:
מגודל מעלת לימוד התורה ע"פ רבינו הקדוש
לוקט על ידי הרה"ח ר' שמואל צ'צ'יק ז"ל
segments.en: It is written in the introduction of the Biur HaLikutim by the holy Tzaddik Reb Avraham son of Reb Noson, of blessed memory: Rabbainu has already informed us that even those commandments that have physical reasons, one should believe that the primary reasons are spiritual — to no end — for "the Torah and the Holy One blessed be He are all one." And similarly regarding the commandment of Torah study, which surpasses all other commandments — as is explained in this matter also in Sefer HaMidos [Learning, §33]: "Habitual study surpasses the fulfillment of all commandments." Even though on the plain level the revealed reason is to know how to conduct oneself in every matter — "the path on which we shall walk and the deed" etc. — even so, also here the primary aspect of the commandment is as a segulah [propitious means] for the success of the soul, according to the spiritual reasons within it. [And see in Sefer HaMidos, Learning §10: "Every piece of knowledge in the laws of the Torah — this very knowledge is itself the success of the soul."] And so it is explained in our Sages of blessed memory in tractate Zevachim regarding the study of the laws of the Temple service — which is halacha l'Moshiach [law for the time of Moshiach] but "expound and receive reward."
